mapper.select: SELECT t1.task_name, t1.task_id, t3.test_answer_id, t3.`status`, t4.test_name FROM ms_task AS t1 LEFT JOIN ms_task_test_answer AS t2 ON t1.task_id = t2.task_id AND t2.del_flag = 0 JOIN ms_test_answer AS t3 ON t2.test_answer_id = t3.test_answer_id AND t3.del_flag = 0 AND t3.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN ms_test AS t4 ON t3.test_id = t4.test_id AND t3.del_flag = 0 WHERE t1.grade = #{grade} AND t1.del_flag=0
